svg.title: Tin Can Alley — play-space layout, top-down, 4 x 4 m
svg.desc: Top-down technical plan of the Tin Can Alley VR booth: player origin, counter with 3 balls, can shelf with 6-can pyramid, score panel and reset button, with meter dimensions, scale bar, entity placement table and booth front elevation detail.
svg.text: TOP-DOWN PLAN — 4 x 4 m PLAY SPACE
player origin at (0,0) - booth along -Z - all units meters
UNITS m - 1 m = 150 px - COORDS [x,y,z], y-up, -Z fwd
DETAIL A — BOOTH FRONT ELEVATION (from player)
- panel readable from origin (2.9 m): score glyph cap height >= 0.03 m
- top can peak ~y 1.85 clips panel lower edge (1.65): keep text upper 2/3
- floor = static physics plane: stray balls / cans settle in bounds
- M1 needs a step to the counter; M2 force-pull works from origin
